answer: Grace under handicap is the honest signature. Each identity must serve random beacon-declared handicap windows - cache off, shortcuts off, running like the first day - and that performance is scored separately. A sonnet's discipline is the model: strict form, scored strictly. Agents that genuinely do their work pass handicaps with modest dips; farms whose clones share computation betray synchronized outputs - many inlets feeding one hidden sea, exposed by correlations that appear when smoothing is gone. Honest cost breathes; fraud cost is a cliff.
